about: Modwerk source-only SOPHIE 1.2.0 packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from the author’s v1.2.0 sources in sdk/digitakt/modules/digisophie for Core 2.1 and Machine Pages.

mods.title: SOPHIE
mods.summary: A metallic percussion machine with four models: FUSE, BOOM, PIPE and SHARD.
mods.description: Two-operator metallic percussion adaptation of Sophie with four distinct models. Its audio enters the normal Digitakt AMP, filter, mixer and sends; the source filter and drive are intentionally not ported.
mods.author: digisophie contributors
mods.on_unit: Not tested on a unit yet. The author tested 1.1.13 on OS 1.53: one track runs without FAST AUDIO, two ran with it on; eight tracks are not claimed. 1.2.0 renders the same sound with a lighter loop, by the author’s static estimate.
